title: HARRY POTTER: Geometries of the Novel (3D Trailer Remix)

shots.title: ACT I - THE BOY WHO LIVED (Ch. 1 - The Put-Outer & The Scar)

keyframe_checks.assertion: Glowing golden lightning bolt sigil is centered inside rotating astronomical Deluminator rings with streetlamp orbs spiraling inward.

shots.title: ACT II - THE GREAT HALL (Ch. 7 - A Thousand Floating Candles)

keyframe_checks.assertion: Gothic cathedral arches frame rows of levitating candles with glowing amber flames beneath a starry enchanted ceiling spiral.

shots.title: ACT III - QUIDDITCH (Ch. 11 - Three Golden Hoops & The Snitch)

keyframe_checks.assertion: Three golden Quidditch hoops and central winged Golden Snitch are intertwined with Crimson and Emerald broomstick light trails.

shots.title: ACT IV - THE PHILOSOPHERS STONE (Ch. 12 & 17 - Mirror of Erised)

keyframe_checks.assertion: Ornate golden Mirror of Erised arch surrounds the glowing crimson Philosopher's Stone and concentric alchemical rings.
